a locus on chromosome 2 containing the Dnajc 17 gene is responsible for susceptibility to congenital thyroid hypoplasia in mouse models of thyroid dysgenesis.

the identification of a new gene involved in thyroid development and function.
the identification of a new gene, Dnajc-17, which is involved in congenital hypothyrodism in mice and is highly expressed in thyroid gland.
a genetic factor involved in the development of congenital thyroid disorders in mice, which is also expressed in human thyroid and may be involved in the development and/or function of human thyroid.
